title: fix(i18n): search results count reads right in ru and ar at every count (objectui#10024)
body:
Fixes #10024
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

The query branch of the full-page search results line picks `search.resultsCount` at exactly one result and `search.resultsCountPlural` at every other count. I reproduced the bug before changing anything. The test renders `SearchResultsPage` inside a real i18next instance booted in the session's language. The pins, committed before the fix, went red with 13 failed and 5 passed:

- `ru` at 2 rendered `2 результатов для "Object"`. CLDR puts 2 in `few`, which needs `результата`. At 21 it rendered `21 результатов` (CLDR `one` needs `результат`), and at 22 it rendered `22 результатов`.
- `ar` rendered the same sentence at every count. `resultsCount` and `resultsCountPlural` were byte-identical (`N نتيجة لـ "Object"`), which is wrong at 2 (dual) and at 3-10 (plural).

In this body the placeholders are spelled COUNT and QUERY. The tree uses the i18next double-brace spelling.

## Route: re-derived; it is the one the repo already uses

Measured at `origin/main` 62597c58:

1. **Is i18next count pluralisation wired?** Yes. Passing `count` sends the lookup through `Intl.PluralRules`. But no pack defines a `_zero`, `_two`, `_few` or `_many` key. Each of the ten packs has 14 `_one` leaves, 7 `_other` leaves and 0 of the other four. The control, `showEmptyRelated_one`, counts 1 in `ru`. So no key in the repo carries a Russian `few` form or an Arabic `two` form.
2. **What does the parity test enforce?** `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` asserts four things:
   - every pack defines every `en` key;
   - no pack defines a key `en` lacks;
   - placeholders match `en`;
   - every plural family carries a base key.

   A `ru` `_few` is a key `en` lacks, so the second assertion refuses it. That is the cap that objectui#9664 recorded. The cap is a consequence of that assertion, not an assertion of its own.
3. **What the repo does instead: the count label.**
   - The `ru` pack's own comment above `perm.facet` names the count label as that pack's device and says it is correct at any number.
   - `ru` `collaboration.commentCount` (`Комментариев: COUNT`) uses it on the same two-key convention as this pair.
   - The `detail.fileCount` and `detail.repeaterItemCount` base keys, and `ar` `calendar.a11y.dayCell`, use it for the categories an `_one`/`_other` family cannot spell.
   - objectui#9266 chose it for `preview.history.items`.

So the change is value-only, in two packs. The count-not-one half of `ru` and `ar` becomes a count label:

- `ru` `resultsCountPlural`: `Результатов по запросу "QUERY": COUNT`
- `ar` `resultsCountPlural`: `عدد نتائج البحث عن "QUERY": COUNT`

The singular halves, the key set, the call site (still `=== 1`) and the other eight packs are unchanged. `SearchResultsPage.tsx` only gains one comment paragraph.

**Locales whose categories collapse:**

- `zh`, `ja` and `ko` have a single CLDR category (`other`). Their two halves were already the same string on purpose, and they are untouched.
- `en` and `de` have exactly `one` and `other`, so the switch is exact for them.
- `es`, `fr` and `pt` reach `many` only from a million up. They are untouched.

**Not taken; recorded for the maintainer; does not block this PR.** A real `few` or `two` form can be reached in only two ways:

- (Y) Every pack, `en` included, carries all six suffix slots. That puts slots that are never selected into `en`, `de`, `zh`, `ja` and `ko`, and it departs from every precedent.
- (C) Relax the no-key-that-en-lacks assertion so that a pack may add a CLDR suffix its own language has. That changes a repo-wide invariant.

Neither was touched here. The report recommends neither.

## Pins

The new test file is `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/SearchResultsPage.resultsCountPlural-10024.test.tsx`. It renders for real with real i18next; `t` is not mocked. It pins:

- `ru` at 1, 2, 5, 21, 22 and 25; `ar` at 0, 1, 2, 3, 11 and 100; and `en` at 1 and 2 as the control.
- The shipped defect, named as strings: `2 результатов`, `21 результатов` and `22 результатов` must not appear, and `ar` must not read the same at 1 as at 2 once the number is masked.
- Interpolation: the number and `"Object"` both reach the screen, and no raw placeholder is left.
- The mechanism, on the pack values: `ru` and `ar` `resultsCountPlural` end in `: COUNT` and differ from `resultsCount`.

## Evidence (HEAD `80b209da`)

- **Reproduction** on the unmodified packs: 13 failed, 5 passed. The 5 that passed are `en` 1, `en` 2, `ru` 1, `ar` 1 and the interpolation case.
- **Test run** from the repo root: `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/i18n/`, the new file, `SearchResultsPage.itemsAvailablePlural-9664`, `SearchResultsPage.records`, `AppPreview` and `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts`. Result: `Test Files 74 passed (74)`, `Tests 1318 passed (1318)`. The new file alone, with the verbose reporter: `Tests 18 passed (18)`.
- **Ablation.** It ran on the committed fix, through objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs` with the two files wrapped one inside the other. It put the old `ru` and `ar` `resultsCountPlural` values back. Result: 13 failed, 5 passed. `ru at 2` and `ar at 2` went red; both `en control` cases stayed green. The restore is proven for both files: the blob matches HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The dispatch proposed ablating the binary switch instead. This route keeps the switch, so the ablation removes the value change.
- **Type-check.** `@object-ui/i18n` exited 0, and so did `@object-ui/app-shell`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test (1 of 4596 files). Before type-checking, `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` ran 28 tasks, all successful.
- **Gates.** All exited 0:
  - `pnpm check:i18n-keys`
  - `pnpm check:i18n-drift` ("0 en value(s) changed")
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)")
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`
  - the changeset fixed, no-major, overwrite and claims checks
- **Lint** covered only the four changed code files: 0 errors. `SearchResultsPage.tsx` has 9 warnings, the same 9 it has at base. This does not replace the full `pnpm lint` run, which CI owns.
- `.changeset/10024-search-results-count-plural-forms.md` declares a patch for `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Acceptance notes

- `fr` and `pt`: CLDR puts 0 in `one`, but the switch gives them the plural at 0. The card does not claim this, common usage accepts it, and it is left alone.
- Lock timings in the report are shared-box seconds.

## Found outside this card (handed to the seat; not filed here)

- **class a.** The same flaw sits on other keys that use the `=== 1` two-key switch:
  - `ru` `common.itemCount` (`COUNT элементов`), which reaches users through the tab-count aria-label in `packages/components` `containers.tsx`;
  - `ru` `detail.reactionCount` (`EMOJI COUNT реакций`), through `ReactionPicker.tsx`.

  Both read the `many` form at 2 and at 21. `ar` `common.itemCount`, `collaboration.commentCount` and `collaboration.reactionCount` carry the 3-10 plural at 2 and at 11 and above.
